title: Epicor Business Analyst / Developer
text: Epicor Business Analyst / Developer at Private Advertiser (Melbourne, CBD & Inner Suburbs; Contract/Temp; salary: not stated). The Company A construction and manufacturing organisation located Melbourne, VIC. Minimum Qualifications or Certification 3 years+ experience as a Business Analyst or Developer working on Epicor 9 or Epicor 10 projects. Demonstrated competencies in analysing and capturing requirements and proposing solutions. Role Description The position requires an energetic, results oriented and proactive individual who is looking to contribute to the ongoing success of the company. You will be responsible for business process definition and design to support the ERP Project to deliver real outcomes for the business and achieve the business goals. Responsibilities Analysis and capture of business and user requirements within the organisation. Provide ‘best practice’ input as a process analyst. Analyse existing business processes, ensure process flows reflect agreed solution design, identify issues and suggest improvements. Engagement with key business stakeholders to ensure buy-in and support of new business processes. Document processes / procedures using MS Word and Visio. Develop template for Process view of training material documentation. Facilitation of requirements gathering. Understand and articulate business process drivers and respond to business oriented requests. Determine the correct agile tools to be used for business analysis and development on the Epicor project. Define the scope and prioritise features and capabilities needed for the Epicor solution to meet the needs of the business. Identification of impacted stakeholders. Liaise with internal stakeholders (Business and IT) to identify the high-level future state processes and undertake gap analysis with the current state processes. Liaise with external stakeholders (Vendor) to ensure the requirements of the business are delivered as per the specification. Liaise with downstream delivery teams - i.e. technology, organisational change, testing and training. Document process models to the right level for the project or initiative as is necessary for current and future state. Ensures the successful completion of all major activities, tasks and deliverables pertaining to the design and delivery stages. Produce requirement artefacts that are fit for purpose. Plans, coordinates and conducts facilitated sessions. Technical Skills Understanding of the Epicor toolset, including BPM, BAQ, Dashboards (including updateable), DMT, etc. Process modelling and business writing experience. Strong working knowledge of MS Office products. Essential Attributes Ability to work within aggressive timeframes but deliver required results with the highest degree of rigor and accuracy. Work efficiently to manage priorities and dependencies. Ability to work according to the project plan in order to meet deliverables and milestones. Attention to detail with a focus on quality deliverables. Ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex issues effectively. Excellent organisational skills and ability to meet deadlines. Personal Qualities Collaborative working style with a strong sense of team work. Ability to effectively work with both internal and external resources and stakeholders. Strong work ethic and self-motivated to achieve results. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Applications must include a Resume and a Photo (head and shoulders) preferred.
